verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of a way for a Segment user to opt out of Segment's own product telemetry or usage tracking. Consent Management and the Privacy Portal are adjacent features: they help Segment customers honor their end users' data-collection preferences and comply with regulations, which is not the same as opting out of telemetry on Segment itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
